newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela sets 35 bln bolivar TEM bill auction.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela sets 35 bln bolivar TEM bill auction.

text.p: The Central Bank of Venezuela announced for Wednesday morning a 35 billion bolivar auction of 179-, 269- and 358-day "monetary stabilization," or TEM, bills at nominal interest rates of up to 25.64 percent.

The bank said it would offer 15 billion bolivars worth of 179-day bills at a nominal interest rate of 24.18 percent, 10 billion bolivars of 269-day bills at 24.90 percent and 10 billion bolivars of 358-day bills at 25.64 percent.
At its auction last week, the central bank sold 40 billion bolivars worth of 179-, 269- and 358-day bills with yields of 24.18 percent, 26.20 percent and 27.71 percent respectively.
